label: Breaking News: The Raptures Are Based at the Lift!

lines.text: What do we really know about the Lift?
Marketed as humanity's gateway to space, the Lift may be something else entirely.
It isn't just a route the Raptures use to reach the surface. It may actually be one of their bases!
In other words, humanity may have built a Rapture base with its own hands!
So what was this so-called "space expansion" really for?
Was the Rapture invasion truly an unforeseen disaster?
Or did they know from the very beginning? When the Lift was built, did they already realize it could be used by aliens? Did they see this coming and move forward anyway?
Right now, the United Forces of Humanity are keeping this buried.
The truth won't surface on its own. If we want answers, we'll have to dig them out ourselves!
